## 3. State of Charge (SOC) Estimator Benchmark

Comparison under intentional $+15\%$ initial condition bias and Gaussian sensor noise:

| Estimator Algorithm | Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) | Convergence Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Coulomb Counting** | 15.02% | Open-loop drift (No convergence) |
| **Extended Kalman Filter (EKF)** | **3.48%** | Rapid asymptotic convergence ($<45\,\text{s}$) |
| **Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF)** | **3.48%** | Optimal non-linear tracking |
| **Machine Learning (Random Forest)** | 15.28% | Data-driven estimation |
